name: Approvals
responsibility: Every approval the child raises: staged, published to the tab session whose thread asked, answered exactly once, settled
description: An approval from a thread that no live tab session owns is cancelled when it arrives. A reload within the grace keeps a tab session's pending approvals, and the end of the session cancels them. A workhorse's approval is shown to the panes of its tab that show its checkout, and the coordinator's to every pane of its tab session.

outgoing.label: an approval, to the panes of its tab session or its checkout
the live tab session that holds the asking thread
outgoing.description: The server composes the tab-session owner and passes routing or lookup callbacks through the public runtime or Browser gateway interfaces. Private server code registers and invokes those callbacks; the runtime modules never import codex-workbench-sessions.ts.
